$comment: Citation registry for the Day 1: Basic Competencies course — a separate registry from content/kb/hhp-ncd/sources.json (each corpus keeps its own, per content/kb/README.md's corpus model), even where the same real source is cited by both. Only publicly resolvable sources belong here. Run `npm run kb:check-sources` before any demo — it checks every corpus, and flags an entry here that no qa-entries.json cites yet. Grows as modules 2-9 are authored (EO 51 Milk Code, RA 10028 Breastfeeding, AO 2015-0053, DC 2021-0486 — see docs/training-modules-plan.md §C) — add a source only once a module actually cites it, not ahead of authoring it. The three DOH source documents themselves are not listed here: they are unpublished working documents with no resolvable public URL, and are checked in as transcriptions at docs/source-material/day1-basic-competencies/ instead.
